seo.description: Sample case study: a year-round grounds plan for a Sidney condo strata, with set visits, hedge trims and a note to council after each visit.

summary: A written, year-round grounds plan for a mid-size condo strata near Beacon Avenue.
scope: Mowing and edging on a seasonal schedule
Visit notes to the property manager
challenge: A condo strata council near Beacon Avenue wanted the same standard all year and one person to call when owners raised concerns.
approach: We wrote a scope that listed the tasks for each visit, plus a calendar for hedge trims and spring and fall cleanups.
After every visit the property manager got a short note of what was done and anything that needed a council decision.
result: Council had a written scope to review each season and a single contact for owner concerns.
